verdict.rationale: Restate ships official SDKs for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go and Rust. The docs cover SDK APIs in depth, including durable steps, timers, error handling, a testing companion library, typed ingress clients and changelogs. A hands-on community report confirms getting an app running quickly with the TS SDK, and the AI coding-agent plugin plus Vercel AI and OpenAI Agents SDK integrations support the AI-native angle. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK docs in the pack for Python and Java/Kotlin, and hands-on corroboration beyond the TypeScript SDK.
